name: 4-MPM
summary: 4-Methylphenmetrazine is an empathogen of the phenylmorpholine class. Reports indicate tolerance for the drug builds fast.

helpfulLinks.title: TripSit Factsheet

pharmacology.text: It was first identified in Slovenia in 2015, and has been shown to act as a monoamine releaser with some preference for serotonin release.

uses.text: 4-Methylphenmetrazine (mephenmetrazine, 4-MPM, PAL-747) is a recreational designer drug with stimulant effects.

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Related phenmetrazine stimulants can cause a racing heart, raised blood pressure, sleeplessness, anxiety and compulsive redosing, and serotonin releasers carry a risk of overheating and serotonin syndrome.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。相關的芬美曲秦類興奮劑可能引起心跳過快、血壓上升、失眠、焦慮與強迫性追加使用，而血清素釋放劑則有體溫過高與血清素症候群的風險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。相关的芬美曲秦类兴奋剂可能引起心跳过快、血压上升、失眠、焦虑与强迫性追加使用，而血清素释放剂则有体温过高与血清素症候群的风险。

fact.en: 4-MPM is phenmetrazine with a methyl group on its ring, the same change that turns methcathinone into mephedrone. Phenmetrazine itself was sold as the diet pill Preludin from the 1950s.
fact.zh: 4-MPM 是在芬美曲秦的苯環上加一個甲基，這和把甲基卡西酮變成甲氧麻黃酮的改變相同。芬美曲秦本身從1950年代起以減肥藥 Preludin 販售。
fact.zhHans: 4-MPM 是在芬美曲秦的苯环上加一个甲基，这和把甲基卡西酮变成甲氧麻黄酮的改变相同。芬美曲秦本身从1950年代起以减肥药 Preludin 贩售。
